defects.fix: Instantiate the bracket-front-left mesh and its x/z mirrors at the top-slab underside / panel top-corner positions given in the spec (y ≈ 0.662, z = ±0.25 on each panel), even as a simple placeholder angle block.

summary: Overall silhouette, top-slab proportions (1.4x0.68x0.018 at 0.73 m height) and the two end panels are close to the reference and camera framing is reasonable. However this is the structural pass and its core promise — every part present and attached — is not met: the four bronze L-brackets and four glide pads called out in mustMatch/detailInventory are absent from the render entirely, and a stray fragment of bracket geometry floats above the top slab on the right side instead of sitting under it. These are exactly the kind of 'missing/unattached part' issues this pass is meant to catch. No fixes remain in the budget, and the object is clearly recognizable as the right kind of desk, so I'm passing it forward to the form/material passes rather than blocking, but the missing brackets and pads should be picked up as outstanding structural debt in a later revision.
